name: Tool-call card
summary: Collapsed-by-default card that shows one tool invocation with its seven-state lifecycle, inputs and outputs.

anatomy.description: The card. Carries data-state (tool lifecycle) and data-effect (read | write | destroy).
The disclosure trigger. Whole row is pressable; aria-expanded lives here.
Tool-category glyph (search, file, terminal, browser). Decorative.
Humanised tool name plus target — "Searching the web for 'oklch contrast'", "Reading src/app.tsx". Never the raw function name.
State badge with text ("Running", "Completed", "Error"); colour is secondary.
Rotates on expand; rotation is paired with the header background change (LQ-STATE-02).
Collapsible region. Hidden by default except on error.
Arguments as highlighted JSON in type.family.mono; truncated with "show all" past 20 lines.
Result, error, or a registered generative-UI component. Never model-supplied HTML.
Retry (on error), Copy (on output), Approve / Deny (when approval-requested).

variants.guidance: Row is a single line with the summary (Claude Code style); card adds a visible border and padding. Grouped runs ("Searched 4 sources") are a row.
Drives data-effect and the status token so writes look different from reads without expansion (LQ-TOOL-02).

states.treatment: Status "Pending" in color.status.pending; name may still be arriving; shimmer on the name, opacity-only under reduced motion.
states.a11y: none until a name exists; then one announcement "Preparing {name}".

states.treatment: Status "Running" in color.status.running with a spinner; elapsed time after 10 s (LQ-WAIT-01).
states.a11y: aria-busy="true" on root; one polite announcement "Running {name}".

states.treatment: Body auto-expands; approval-prompt rendered inside; the card is outlined in color.status.warning.
states.a11y: Assertive announcement "Approval needed: {verb} {object}"; focus moves to the prompt.

states.treatment: Status "Approved" or "Denied"; the prompt collapses to one line recording the decision.
Status "Completed" in color.status.success; collapses to a one-line summary ("Read 3 files"); spinner removed.
states.a11y: aria-busy removed; one polite announcement "{name} complete".

states.treatment: Status "Error" in color.status.error with an icon; body auto-expands to show the message; Retry visible.
states.a11y: role="alert" on the message, not the whole card.

states.treatment: Status "Denied" in color.fg.muted; no output; one line explaining who denied it.
Header background shifts one step; chevron rotates; body visible.
states.a11y: aria-expanded="true" on the header button; body has the header as aria-labelledby.

states.treatment: Ring on the header button and on each action.
none — a tool card is never disabled; it is denied or errored.

props.name: state
props.description: Rendered from the tool machine, never inferred from content (message-state-machine).

props.name: name
props.description: Humanised, with target. The implementation does not humanise; the caller does, so the mapping is one place.

props.name: output
props.description: A registered component (a framework element, a custom element, a DOM node) may be passed for generative UI.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Forced true by the implementation when state is output-error or approval-requested.

api.composition: Built from disclosure + badge + code-block + spinner + card. Output is a slot so a product can render its own component for a tool's result; the card never renders HTML strings.

accessibility.name: Root is labelled by the name part; the body is labelled by the header.

keyboard.action: Moves through header, then visible actions. Collapsed body contents are not in the tab order.

accessibility.focus: On approval-requested, focus moves to the approval prompt's safe option (Deny). On output-error, focus does not move; the alert role announces.
accessibility.announcements: Exactly one announcement per state change, polite except approval-requested (assertive). Batched when several cards change within 2 s (LQ-A11Y-01).

content.label: Humanised verb + target. "Searching the web for 'x'", "Reading src/app.tsx", "Running npm test". Group repeats: "Searched 4 sources".
content.voice: Progressive while running ("Reading"), past tense when done ("Read 3 files"), plain on error ("Couldn't read src/app.tsx: permission denied").
content.limits: Never the raw function name or a UUID in the visible name. Never "Processing…" without a target.

use_when: Any tool-using model or agent, one card per invocation, grouped when repeated.
avoid_when: Expanding every call by default (a wall of JSON).
Rendering model-supplied HTML as the output.
Showing a spinner without a name and target for more than 2 s (LQ-TOOL-01).

instead.when: Many steps over a long run that need scanning and jumping
The action needs a decision before it runs

exemplars: AI Elements Tool — the seven-state vocabulary with badges; adopt the names, collapse completed by default.
Claude Code — one-line tool summaries in the transcript; the row density variant.
CopilotKit — tool result rendered as a registered React component; the output slot.

local.title: Render from state, not content
local.statement: The card's visual state is driven by the `state` prop from the tool lifecycle; it is never inferred from the output text (e.g. "contains 'error'" or "ends with ```").

detect.static: No string matching on output/input in the state logic.

local.fix: Consume the machine's state; see message-state-machine.

local.title: Error and approval auto-expand; everything else collapses
local.statement: output-error and approval-requested open the body automatically; all other states are collapsed by default with a one-line summary visible.

detect.runtime: For each state, assert the body's visibility matches the rule.

local.fix: Derive `open` from state unless the user has toggled it.

local.title: Never render model HTML
local.statement: Output is JSON, text, or a component registered by the product; a string from the model is never set as innerHTML.

detect.static: dangerouslySetInnerHTML / v-html / innerHTML inside the output part.

local.fix: Render text, or map the tool name to a registered component.

local.title: Group repeats
local.statement: Three or more consecutive calls to the same tool collapse into one grouped card ("Searched 4 sources") with the individual calls inside.

detect.static: A grouping step exists before render.

local.fix: Group by tool name in the message renderer.

resolved.title: No state by colour alone
resolved.statement: No state is expressed by colour alone; every state has a second channel (icon, weight, border, position or text).

detect.static: A state's class delta changes only color/background-color.
detect.runtime: Grayscale the screenshot of each state and check it still differs from enabled.

resolved.fix: Add an icon, border, weight or text change alongside the colour change.

resolved.title: Every state reaches the accessibility tree
resolved.statement: Every visible state has an ARIA expression or an explicit "none" in the spec; selected, expanded, invalid, busy and current are never visual-only.

detect.static: For each state the component declares, the matching attribute (aria-selected, aria-expanded, aria-invalid, aria-busy, aria-current, aria-checked) is present when the state is active.

resolved.fix: Set the attribute the APG pattern specifies; do not invent a new one.

resolved.title: Never remove focus without replacing it
resolved.statement: No `outline: none` / `outline-0` / `focus:outline-none` without a `:focus-visible` replacement that has ≥3:1 contrast against both the component and the page.

detect.static: Class or style removes outline and no focus-visible ring class/rule exists on the same element.
detect.runtime: Tab to the element; the focused and unfocused screenshots must differ at ≥3:1 along the element's edge.

resolved.fix: Use `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring ring-offset-2` (or the binding's equivalent) and keep `:focus` untouched.

resolved.title: Native element first
resolved.statement: Prefer the native element (button, a, select, details, input) until a product requirement makes it impossible; a div or span with a click handler and a role is a defect unless the spec names an exception.

detect.static: div|span with onClick/onKeyDown and no native equivalent in the subtree.

resolved.fix: Replace with the native element; keep the styling.

resolved.title: Every control has an accessible name
resolved.statement: Every interactive element has an accessible name from content, a label, aria-label or aria-labelledby; placeholder text and title attributes do not count.

detect.static: Compute the accessible name per accname 1.2; empty is a failure.

resolved.fix: Add visible text, a <label>, or aria-label for icon-only controls.

resolved.title: No literal values
resolved.statement: Component styles read token roles only, through the binding's custom properties; no literal colours, radii, shadows, durations or z-indexes (`#7c3aed`, `oklch(…)`, `border-radius: 12px`, `z-index: 50`, `300ms`).
resolved.rationale: Tokens are the primer; the component is the finish. A literal value breaks every theme at once.

detect.static: A declaration on a component part sets colour, radius, shadow, duration or z-index to anything other than `var(--lq-…)` (or a utility class that does not resolve to a role through the binding).

resolved.fix: Replace with the role's custom property from the binding (see spec/bindings/html.yaml).

resolved.title: Parts are addressable
resolved.statement: Every anatomy part renders with `data-slot="<part>"` so docs, tests and the grader can target it without classes.

detect.static: For each anatomy part marked required, an element with that data-slot exists.

resolved.fix: Add data-slot to the part's root element.

resolved.title: Reduced motion is honoured
resolved.statement: Any transition longer than 150 ms or any looping animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion` branch that removes movement (opacity-only is fine).

detect.static: Animation/transition utilities present without a motion-reduce: variant or media query.
detect.runtime: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion and assert no transform-based animation is running.

resolved.fix: Add `motion-reduce:transition-none` / `motion-reduce:animate-none` or an equivalent media query.

resolved.title: Name the tool and its target
resolved.statement: A tool call that takes more than 2 s shows its name and target (file, URL, query), not just a spinner.

detect.runtime: Tool card contains non-empty name and target text nodes before the 2 s mark.

resolved.title: Writes look different from reads
resolved.statement: Write and destructive tool calls are visually distinct from reads without expansion.

detect.static: Tool cards carry data-effect="read|write|destroy" mapped to distinct tokens.

resolved.title: Collapsed by default
resolved.statement: Reasoning, tool detail and sources are collapsed by default behind a one-line summary; expanding is the user's choice.

detect.static: Collapsible defaults closed; a summary line stays visible while closed.

resolved.title: Polite, throttled live regions
resolved.statement: Streaming regions use aria-live="polite" and announce status changes at most once per 2 s.

detect.runtime: Live region present; no aria-live="assertive" on streams; throttled updates.

resolved.title: Keep the input, offer Retry
resolved.statement: Every error state preserves the user's input and offers Retry.

detect.static: Error component contains a retry action; composer value unchanged after error.

resolved.title: Indicator by 400 ms
resolved.statement: Any pending agent response shows a visible indicator within 400 ms, a text status by 5 s, and elapsed time by 10 s.

good.title: A read and a write side by side

anti.title: Deciding the state by searching the output for "error"

grading.notes: In an agent transcript this is the most repeated component; the grader checks the state coverage of the whole set, not each card.
